title: CI speed: remove the O(files x stems) hot loop in check_unwired_artifacts.scan, then the live-queue test recomputation
note: [2026-10-26 lane] MEASURED by manager: pytest-run 14.4 min (10-13) -> 28-39; slowest test test_phase_g_sunset_and_pull sunset_pass self-test 259.5 s, 257 of it in check_unwired_artifacts.scan. MEASURED: full tree 1333 targets old 96.3 s -> new 12.4 s with byte-identical findings (191); sunset_pass --self-test now 23.8 s. FIX 2 (next PR): live-queue tests re-running dispatcher/parser; no skips/weakened asserts. Closes when pytest-run p50 is observed back under ~15 min.
